description: あげる (1) Someone gives something to a person who is not a member of the giver’s in group but whose status is about equal to that of the giver.
meaning: Give
example: I gave Yoshiko flowers.

description: Some state or action takes place at a time (not always immediately) after another state or action has taken place.
meaning: After
example: Mr. Mason became ill after he went to Japan.

description: The degree of something is not great.
meaning: (not) very much; (not) very
example: This book is not very good.

description: During a period when a certain situation remains in effect.
meaning: While; before; during
example: Mr. Maeda's English improved while he was in America.

description: Do something in advance for future convenience.
meaning: Do something in advance; go ahead and do something; let someone/something remain as he/it is
example: Since we are having a party tomorrow, I bought some beer for it.

description: Can't tell if ~
meaning: Might
example: It might rain in the afternoon.

description: An auxiliary verb attached to a psychological/physiological adjective meaning a person other than the speaker shows signs of ~
meaning: Show signs of ~
example: Kazuo showed signs of wanting a sports car.

description: Approximate quantity or extent.
meaning: Approximately; about
example: It's about nine hours by plane from Tokyo to San Francisco.

description: A disjunctive subordinate conjunction that combines two sentences.
meaning: Although; though
example: Although I didn't tell him, Tom knew (about it).

description: Something takes place regularly in succession after a certain temporal or spatial interval.
meaning: Every
example: I took medicine every three hours.

description: A volitional decision to do something is made.
meaning: Decide to
example: I decided to quit my company.

description: An event takes place as if spontaneously, irrespective of the speaker's volition.
meaning: It will be decided that ~; come about ~; be arranged that ~; turn out that ~
example: I'm going to be transferred to Osaka next year.

description: Speaking of proposition X, X is certainly true.
meaning: Indeed one does something alright, (but ~); indeed ~ (but ~); do ~ (but ~)
example: I do play tennis, but I am not good at it.

description: Approximately (with a specific point of time).
meaning: About; around
example: Mr. Suzuki leaves home at about 7:00 o'clock in the morning.

description: A suffix that makes a noun out of an adjective by attaching it to the stem of an Adj (い) or much less frequently to the stem of an Adj (な)
meaning: -ness; -ly
example: This size of this house is just right.

description: Cause someone/something to do something or cause something to change its state.
meaning: Make someone/something do something; cause someone/something to do something; let someone/something do something; allow someone/something to do something; have someone/something do something; get someone/something to do something.
example: Mr. Suzuki made/let his daughter go to college.

description: A conjunction to indicate ‘and’ in an emphatic way.
meaning: And what’s more; not only ~ but also ~; so
example: I not only played tennis but also saw a movie today.

description: An infix attached to the stem of an adjective い to indicate something that one cannot objectively measure on any scale (e.g. human emotion).
A particle which marks an element X when nothing but X makes the expressed proposition true.
meaning: Nothing/nobody/no ~ but; only
example: No one but Mr. Toda smokes.

description: An auxiliary verb which indicates the completion of an action.
meaning: Have dome something; finish doing something; finish something up
example: Mr. Ikeda finished reading the book in three days.

description: A particle that indicates equal distribution of quantity.
meaning: By; at a time.
example: I memorize five kanji every day.

description: A coordinate conjunction which connects two sentences (the second sentence either describes an event which takes place right after the event described in the first sentence or it expresses a logical guess related to the event in the first sentence.)
meaning: Thereupon ~; then ~; and ~
example: I began jogging. Then, I began to have a good appetite.

description: Some situation which seldom occurs has now occurred and one can either make use of it or, to one’s regret, cannot make use of it.
meaning: With effort; at great pain; take the trouble to do ~
example: I took the trouble to go see my friend, but he wasn't at home.

description: A coordinate conjunction that connects two sentences.
meaning: And; and then
example: I went to Tokyo today. And I met my friend there.

description: A conjunction that indicates (1) temporally contiguous actions or states, or (2) a cumulative listing of objects, actions or states.
meaning: After that; and then; in addition to that
example: Yesterday I drank with my friend for about two hours and then went home.

description: A conjunction to indicate that what is stated in the preceding sentence is the reason or cause for what is stated in the following sentence.
meaning: And; because of that; that is why; therefore; so
example: I had a cold yesterday. That's why I took a day off from school.

description: If that is the case
meaning: If so; then; well then
example: A: This orange is not sweet.

description: A coordinate conjunction which connects two alternatives expressed by sentences.
meaning: Or; either ~ or ~
example: It's either that this book is wrong or that I am wrong.

description: If that is the case,
meaning: Then; in that case
example: A: I have a headache.  B: In that case, go to sleep right away.

description: An auxiliary adjective which expresses a desire to do something.
meaning: Want (to do something); would like (to do something)
example: I want to go to Japan.

description: A sentence final particle which indicates an interrogative word question in informal male speech.
A particle which expresses a limit imposed upon something that is growing and expanding.
meaning: Only; just; alone; merely; that’s all
example: Only Mr. Smith came.

description: Even if someone did something or something were in some state (the desired result would not come about) or even if someone or something is in some state.
meaning: Even if ~
example: Even if I tell him that, he won't understand it.

description: A subordinate conjunction which indicates that the action/state expressed by the main clause in a sentence takes place after the action/state expressed by the subordinate clause.
meaning: If; when; after
example: When/If Mr. Yamada comes, I'll go home.

description: A phrase which expresses a suggestion (literally: How would you feel if you do something?)
meaning: Why don't you do ~?; what about doing ~?

description: An auxiliary indicating the speaker’s conjecture which is not based on any particular information or evidence.
meaning: Probably
example: Ms. Anderson will probably go to Japan.

description: って (2) A colloquial quotation marker.
meaning: That
example: Jane said that she wouldn't dance / They say that Jane won't dance.

description: An intention or conviction of a speaker (or a person with whom the speaker can empathise) about his future or past actions or current state.
meaning: Intend to ~; be convinced that ~; believe; feel sure that ~; be going to; mean
example: I intend to get married next year.

description: The て form ending of verbs and い-type adjectives (The て form ending of な-type adjectives and the て form of the copula is で.)
meaning: And; -ing
example: Jim went to Japan and studied (there).

meaning: Even if; although
example: I'll go there even if it rains.

description: A phrase which expresses persmission or concession.
meaning: May; It is all right if
example: A: May I smoke here?  B: Yes, you may.

description: A phrase marking information which identifies or explains the noun following the phrase.
meaning: Called; that says ~; that
example: I read a novel called Snow Country.

description: A conjunction that lists two or more items, actions or states as inexhaustive examples.
meaning: And; or
example: I like Bach, Mozart and Beethoven, among others.

description: ところだ (1) A place is in a location which takes a certain amount of time to get to.
meaning: ~ is (in) a place where it takes ~ to get to
example: My house is in a place where it takes ten minutes to get to from the station on foot. / On foot my house is ten minutes from the station.

description: A compound particle which indicates the capacity, role or function of someone or something.
meaning: As; in the capacity of
example: Mr. Tanaka was hired as a salesman.

description: A compound particle which indicates a standard for comparisons.
meaning: For
example: This steak is inexpensive for Japanese steak.

description: An expression which presents as the topic of a following discourse a phrase which has just been uttered.
meaning: Speaking of ~
example: A: I borrowed this book from Mr. Tanaka.  B: Speaking of Mr. Tanaka, I wonder if he's gotten over his illness yet.

description: A negative imperative marker used by a male speaker in very informal speech
meaning: Don't do ~

description: A negative て form of a verb.
meaning: Do not do something and; without doing ~
example: Nancy went to school yesterday without eating her breakfast.

description: A conjunction which indicates that the action expressed by the preceding verb takes place concurrently or simultaneously with the action expressed in the main clause.
meaning: While; over; with
example: Mr. Taguchi always reads a newspaper while eating his breakfast.

description: A て form of the negative ない, which indicates a cause/reason for a state or action.
meaning: Do not do something and ~; is not ~ and ~; because ~ do not do something
example: I couldn't get up at seven and was late for work (at my company).

description: It has reached the point where some state or action does not take place anymore.
meaning: Not ~ any more
example: I cannot even write easy kanji any more.

description: It won’t do if someone does not take some action or if someone or something is not in some state.
meaning: Have to; must; need
example: A: Don't you have work today?  B: Yes, I have work.

description: A polite imperative used by superiors such as parents or teachers to their inferiors (=people of younger age and lower rank)
meaning: Do something
example: Eat more.

description: A marker that indicates exemplification.
meaning: And so on; and the like; for example; things like ~
example: Among Japanese foods I like things like sushi and tempura.

description: A conjunction which indicates that the preceding sentence is the speaker’s supposition about the truth of a present or past fact or the actualisation of something in the future.
meaning: If it is true that; if it is the case that; if; would; could
example: If it is true that Matsuda will come, I won't go.

description: A phrase that indicates a generally agreed upon standard (the entire sentence that includes this phrase expresses some deviation from that standard.)
meaning: For ~; considering that ~
example: Mr. Takayama is big for a Japanese person.

description: Someone has decided on something.
meaning: Decide on ~; make it ~
example: I've decided on this apartment.

description: A conjunction which indicates that the preceding clause expresses a conditional.
meaning: If
example: If you take this medicine, you'll get well.

description: A phrase which indicates prohibition.
meaning: Cannot do something; must not do something; don’t do something; should not do something
example: You must not enter this room.

description: A particle which indicates that something is the only thing or state which exists, or the action someone will take, takes, is taking or took.
meaning: Only; just; be ready to do something; have just done something; just did something; be just doing something; about
example: The only thing left to do with the dessert is to eat it./The dessert is ready to eat.

description: A dependant noun which expresses the speaker’s expectation that something will take place or took place or that someone/something is or was in some state.
meaning: I expect that ~; it is expected that ~; ~ is expected to; I am fairly certain that ~; should; ought to; it is natural that ~; no wonder ~
example: I expect that Mr. Clark will go to the party.

description: A phrase which expresses the speaker’s regret.
meaning: I wish ~ had done something
example: I wish I had asked my teacher.

description: A particle that indicates the direction toward which some directional movement or action proceeds.
meaning: To; towards
example: I went on a trip to Kyoto last week.

description: It is strongly suggested that someone do something.
meaning: Had better do something
example: You'd better read Japanese books.

description: A particle which indicates an extent or a degree to which someone/something does something or is in some state.
meaning: To the extent of; to the extent that ~; (not as) ~ as ~; about
example: I'm not as strong as Ken.

description: A particle to indicate a spatial, temporal or quantitative limit or an unexpected animate/inanimate object.
meaning: As far as; till; up to; until; through; even
example: Yesterday I played tennis from three to five with my friend.

description: A particle that indicates a time limit on/for an action.
meaning: By; by the time (when)
example: I'll come home by 10 o'clock.

description: An already given situation or condition remains unaltered.
meaning: As it is; unchanged; undisturbed; leave as is; remain
example: My younger brother went to sleep leaving the TV on.

description: Do something to see what it’s like or what will happen.
meaning: Do something and see; try to do something
example: I will read Japanese novels (to see what they are like).

description: もらう (1)The first person or someone the speaker empathises with receives something from someone whose status is not as high as the receiver’s.
meaning: Get; receive; be given
example: I got a book from Mr. Yamamoto.

description: A coordinate conjunction that is used to list two or more items (nouns or noun phrases) in an inexhaustive fashion.
meaning: And
example: Mr. Yamada and Mr. Ogawa (and others) came.

description: An adverb indicating that the actual situation expectedly/anticipatively conforms to a standard based on past experience, comparison with other people, or common sense.
meaning: Still; also; after all; as expected; you know
example: As expected, Mr.

description: An auxiliary な type adjective which expresses the likelihood of something/someone or the likeness of something/someone to something/someone.
meaning: Look like; look as if; be like; appear; seem
example: It appears that Mr. Sugiyama is going to America.

description: The speaker desires or decides to do something.
meaning: ~ think ~ will
example: I think I will read Japanese history (books).

description: Someone causes some circumstantial or behavioural change to take place.
meaning: Do ~ in such a way that ~; see to it that ~; make sure that ~; bring it about that ~
example: I'll make sure that I do exercises everyday.

description: Some change takes place gradually.
meaning: Reach the point where ~; come to ~; it has come to be that ~; have finally become
example: Mr. Jackson has reached the point where he can speak Japanese.

description: Tell someone in such a way that he will do something.
meaning: Tell ~ to ~; say ~ in such a way
example: The teacher told his students to do homework.

description: より (2)A particle which indicates a set point in terms of space or time.
meaning: In ~ of; inside; outside; before; after
example: Mexico is located north of the equator.

description: An auxiliary adjective which indicates that the preceding sentence is the speaker’s conjecture based on what he has heard, read or seen.
meaning: Seem; look like; apparently; I heard
example: It seems that Mr. Matsuda is going to America.

description: られる (1)A state or an action cannot be controlled by someone or something.
meaning: Be –ed; get –ed
example: Ichiro was deceived by Hanako.

description: The speaker's conclusion obtained through deductive, logical judgment or calculation on the basis of what he has heard or read.
meaning: No wonder; so it means that ~; that's why; should ~; I take it that ~; naturally
example: Are you studying Japanese (as long as) three hours every day? No wonder your Japanese is good.

description: The speaker or whomever he empathises with cannot cope with a situation expressed by the て phrase.
meaning: Unbearably ~; extremely; be dying to do ~
example: It is unbearably hot today.

description: An adverb that indicates the speaker/writer's emotive conviction.
meaning: Really; truly; indeed
example: From an American perspective, Japanese society is indeed closed.

description: Vます of the auxiliary verb おる.
meaning: Be ~ and
example: This entrance is for employees only and other people (literally: general people) cannot enter from here.

description: Contrary to one's expectation an opposite result comes about.
meaning: On the contrary; rather
example: I took medicine, and the illness got worse (contrary to my expectation).

description: An auxiliary adjective which expresses the idea that for someone to do something is virtually impossible or impossible.
meaning: Cannot; un—able; can hardly; difficult to; impossible
example: What he did is unforgivable.

description: A suffix to express an undesirable tendency in someone or something.
meaning: Tend to; be prone to; be apt to; be liable to; be subject to; often
example: Tanaka tends to miss classes these days.

description: A conjunction to indicate the speaker's assertion that a popular belief is not right.
meaning: You would think that ~ but (that is not right)
example: You would think that all the Japanese like sushi, but that is not true. Some Japanese don't like it.

description: A sentence-final particle that indicates a self-addressed question or a question addressed to an in-group member.
meaning: I wonder if ~
example: I wonder what I should do this weekend.

description: An auxiliary expressing that someone cannot do something even if s/he wants to do it.
meaning: Cannot; be not in a position to; hardly possible; hard; hesitate to do
example: I am not in a position to figure out that matter, so please ask the departmental chief.

description: A conjunction which introduces the reason for someone's action or for someone's having some idea, and conveys disapproval of the action or idea.
meaning: Just because; even if; even though
example: I cannot forgive him just because he is a child.

description: An auxiliary indicating the writer's conjecture which is not based on any particular information or evidence.
meaning: Probably
example: It is probably difficult to predict what one's self will be like in ten years time.

description: A continuative form of an い-type adjective.
meaning: And; so
example: Kanako's personality was cheerful and innocent.

description: A conjunction which expresses the speaker's contempt, anger, or disagreement about someone's action, behaviour, or state.
meaning: Although; in spite of the fact that; and yet; but
example: Although Mr. Yamada is Japanese, he doesn't know many kanji.

description: A demonstrative which refers to someone or something mentioned as an example in previous discourse.
meaning: Such; like this
example: We do not seem to hear about problems like this in this country.

description: A particle which emphasizes a word, phrase, or clause.
meaning: The very ~; it is ~; that ~; only (when, after, because, etc.); in particular; precisely; definitely;
example: This is the very thing that we've been looking for.

description: An auxiliary noun to express a command.
meaning: (don't) V; should (not); (not) ought to; may not
example: Each presentation should be completed (literally: done) within fifteen minutes.

description: A compound particle which indicates a means or a cause.
meaning: By V-ing; because; result in; cause
example: I try to lift my spirits by playing golf on weekends.

description: A phrase which is used to present an event as the cause of something.
meaning: Be due to the fact that; be caused by; be brought about by; be the result of; because
example: The failure this time is the result of insufficient discussion beforehand (literally: due to the fact that the preceding discussion was insufficient).

description: A phrase which expresses the idea that there is no need to do something or that there is no possibility of doing something.
meaning: There is no need to; not necessary; there is no possibility that; there is no chance to
example: There's no need to listen to a man like that.

description: A demonstrative adjective which indicates a time or time period around the moment of speech.
meaning: The last; this past; this; this coming
example: Miss Akiyama will marry (this spring / this coming spring).

description: An emphatic particle which expresses the idea of "even" in non-conditional clauses (or sentences) or the idea of "only" in conditional clauses.
meaning: Even; if ~ only; if ~ just; as long as; the only thing ~ need is
example: She can read even classical Japanese, not to mention modern Japanese.

description: An adverb that expresses the speaker's/writer's strong feeling that something has turned out as s/he expected.
meaning: As might be expected; after all; it is only natural that ~; naturally; truly; really; indeed; impressive
example: Because Mr. Nelson has studied in Japan for three years, naturally he speaks Japanese well.

description: An auxiliary indicating that there is no other choice but to do something.
meaning: Cannot help -ing; cannot (help) but; have no choice but to ~; have to
example: It was a textbook so I had no choice but to buy it, although it was expensive.

description: A conjunction which is used to provide additional important information.
meaning: Moreover; furthermore; besides; on top of that; what's more; what's worse; more surprisingly; at that; nevertheless; and yet; even so
example: The tape recorders available these days are compact and light, and on top of that, their sound has improved greatly.

description: A conjunction that is used to indicate that a result/situation follows necessarily from the foregoing situation.
meaning: Therefore; accordingly; consequently
example: The budget is insufficient. Therefore this plan cannot be implemented.

description: Without having much temporal or physical distance.
meaning: At once; soon; right away; immediately; readily; instantly; easily; right
example: I went to sleep as soon as I got home.

description: A dependent noun expressing a cause which brings about an undesirable result.
meaning: Because; due to
example: Because of the depression, cars are not selling well this year.

description: An adverb that indicates the speaker/writer's minimally satisfactory level.
meaning: At least
example: I am not saying that I want to get 100 points, but I would like to get at least 80 points.

description: A sentence final particle that emphasises a male speaker's emotion about something in his monologue or his strong desire to draw someone else's attention.
meaning: I tell you; I'm telling you; you know

description: A structure which expresses that the speaker/writer cannot easily accept the corollary from the preceding statement owing to some circumstances, although he feels like accepting it
meaning: But; yet; even so
example: A: I hear that fish is good for your health. B: But we couldn't eat just fish every day, you know.

description: A phrase expressing that something almost happens.
meaning: Almost
example: While walking in the cold rain without using an umbrella, I almost caught a cold.

description: A phrase expressing that something almost happens.
meaning: Almost
example: While walking in the cold rain without using an umbrella, I almost caught a cold.

description: A conjunction which connects a situation presented as a reason and an action taken because of that situation
meaning: So; because of that; therefore
example: My friend told me that something simple would be fine for supper. So, I ordered a pizza.

description: A conjunction used to indicate that in spite of the negative situation mentioned in the previous part of the sentence/discourse some positive effort is made.
meaning: But; in spite of that
example: Tom is small for a football player, but he makes up for it with his swift legs.

description: A conjunction which introduces an additional, emphatic statement.
meaning: On top of that; besides; moreover; furthermore; what's more; what's worse; not only ~ but also
example: He looked for an apartment with me, and moreover, he even helped me move.

description: An interjection which signals that the speaker is going to provide an unexpected response to a question.
meaning: Well (contrary to your expectation; I'm afraid to say this, but)
example: A: Does it look like you can get a scholarship? B: Well, (no,) it looks difficult.

description: Each of two or more things/persons.
meaning: Each; respectively
example: Yamada and Suzuki bought fruits and cakes, respectively.

description: In spite of the circumstance expressed in the preceding sentence.
meaning: Nevertheless; yet; but in spite of that; even so
example: The parents are opposed to the couple's marriage. Nevertheless, they seem intent to marrying.

description: A conjunction which introduces an additional item or statement.
meaning: And; also; in addition; as well
example: Give me three apples and two oranges, and three bananas, as well.

description: A conjunction that is used to indicate that the level/degree of a fact or a situation expressed in the second sentence is far above or below the level/degree of a fact or a situation expressed in the first sentence.
meaning: On the contrary; far from that; as a matter of fact
example: Mr. Smith cannot write kanji. As a matter of fact, he cannot write even hiragana satisfactorily.

description: A conjunction which introduces an additional item or statement.
meaning: (and) in addition; moreover; furthermore; what's more; on top of that
example: The "morning set" here includes coffee and some toast; in addition, there is a boiled egg (literally: it is accompanied by a boiled egg).

description: An interjection which is used when the speaker emphatically provides an expected response to a question.
meaning: (yes,) naturally; (yes,) of course; oh, surely
example: A: I bet you want to win (the game). B: (Yes,) of course, I do.

description: A conjunction which is used to add more specific information to information about a rather uncommon action or state.
meaning: What's more; what's worse; at that; furthermore; moreover; on top of that
example: Because he spoke (literally: I was talked to) in English, and what's worse, rapidly, I didn't understand anything.

description: A conjunction that expresses something that is contrasted with what is expressed in the previous sentence.
meaning: But; however; yet; nevertheless
example: Japanese economic power is growing, but we can't tell how long it will last.

description: A coordinate conjunction indicating that even if one accepts a premise expressed in the preceding sentence(s) one cannot jump to an expected conclusion from the premise.
meaning: However, it doesn't follow from this that ~; but it doesn't mean that ~; because of that
example: Mr. Cheng is not good at Japanese. On a test he cannot even finish half of it. But it doesn't follow from this that he is not smart.

description: A phrase which expresses the idea that just doing something is enough for something.
meaning: Just V-ing is enough; can just ~; just by V-ing
example: You can just sit (literally: be sitting) here.

description: An adverb which emphasizes the idea of "only".
meaning: Only; just; simply; that's all
example: His only (one) defect is that he is not punctual (literally: he is slack about time).

description: Not deserving to be mentioned.
meaning: Usual; ordinary; plain; common; rank and file
example: I'm only an ordinary employee, so I'm not aware of that.

description: Even if an action or a state were realised.
meaning: Even if
example: No matter how low we estimate the construction expense it will go beyond 500 million yen.

description: A conjunction to express that each time someone/something does something, something else takes place.
meaning: Every time; each time; on every occasion; whenever
example: Each time I go to Japan I come home having learned something new.

description: A suffix that indicates that something/someone is covered or filled with something undesirable.
meaning: Full of; filled with; covered with
example: Mr. Smith is always wearing shoes covered with mud.

description: (1) an auxiliary which expresses an action in progress; (2) a conjunction which is used to present two concurrent actions.
meaning: -ing; while; although
example: A typhoon is approaching Kyushu.

description: An auxiliary which expresses the idea that someone or something keeps doing something, or someone leaves something in an improper state.
meaning: Keep -ing; have been -ing; leave
example: The Shinkansen was so crowded that I stood all the way (literally: kept standing) from Tokyo to Kyoto.

description: A suffix that indicates someone/something has some distinctive characteristic or an attribute identified by a noun, an adjective, or a verb to which the suffix is attached.
meaning: Apt to; easy to; -ish; -like
example: A yakuza-like man wearing sunglasses was standing at the comer of the street.

description: An adverb that is used to summarise or rephrase what has been mentioned/stated in the preceding context.
meaning: That is (to say); namely; in short; to sum up; in other words; after all; that means
example: The Berlin Wall fell apart. This means that the storm of democratization has started.

description: A particle which indicates a basic quantity, for each of which certain amount is associated.
meaning: For; per
example: We will pay 2.000 yen per page for this translation.

description: A copula which is used in formal writing and formal speech.
meaning: Be
example: Botchan is representative of Soseki's early work.

description: An auxiliary which indicates the writer's conjecture which is not based on any particular information or evidence.
meaning: Probably
example: The Japanese economy will probably still keep growing (literally: from now on, too).

description: A conjunction which presents an action/state as a topic about which a negative comment is given.
meaning: If; when; because
example: If you study that hard, you will ruin your health.

description: A phrase which expresses the idea that someone does something or something happens only after something else happens or something else is done.
meaning: Not until; only after; for the first time
example: It was not until I came to America that I saw a tornado.

description: A particle which makes an adverbial clause, with a verb of saying/thinking/understood after it.
meaning: (thinking/saying) that ~; because; like; in such a way that ~
example: Yukio is very happy that he can buy a house next year.

description: A phrase which changes a sentence into a topic noun clause.
meaning: That; the fact that
example: It is unthinkable that he won't come to this meeting.

description: A conjunction to indicate that an action/state takes place quite contrary to one's expectation.
meaning: But; although; in spite of the fact that ~
example: It is April, but still chilly (literally: cold on the skin).

description: というのは~ことだ A structure which is used in interpreting, explaining, or defining a word, a phrase, or a sentence.
meaning: Mean; the meaning of ~ is; what ~ means is
example: Pasokon means personal computer.

description: というより（は）A phrase that is used to indicate more accurate characterisation of someone or something.
meaning: Rather than; more ~ than ~
example: This summer was cold rather than cool.

description: というより（は）A phrase that is used to indicate more accurate characterisation of someone or something.
meaning: Rather than; more ~ than ~
example: This summer was cold rather than cool.

description: A phrase which expresses a manner or a way in which someone does something.
meaning: In such a way that; in such a fashion to suggest/show (etc.) that; as if to say/show (etc.) that
example: He shook his head as if to say that there was no way out.

description: An adverb that indicates the speaker/writer's feeling that no matter what s/he does or how s/he does it, the situation will not change.
meaning: In any case; anyway; at all events; after all; at all
example: I decided not to try for the Education Ministry's Scholarship, because I'd be doomed to failure.

description: An adverb that is used to express the eventual arrival of an expected situation.
meaning: Finally; at (long) last; eventually; in the end; after all
example: It's been threatening to rain since the morning and finally it started to rain. (literally: The rain which threatened to fall from the morning finally started to fall.

description: An adverb to indicate that one cannot make a definite statement about something due to lack of hard evidence.
meaning: I don't know why but; I cannot manage to; just; from what I gather; seem; no matter how ~; I gather that ~; for some reason
example: I tried, but I cannot understand the meaning of this Japanese sentence very well.

description: A conjunction that is used to give an uncertain reason for something.
meaning: For some reason like ~; saying something like ~; because ~ or something like that
example: Mr. Takagi didn't show up at the party, saying something like he was going to make a business trip to Osaka.

description: A dependent noun which is used to express the idea that when someone did something, something took place as the result.
meaning: When; then
example: When I consulted with my teacher, he strongly advised me to go to graduate school.

description: A conjunction which is used to present what in fact happened or what is in fact the case when something else was/is expected.
meaning: However; but
example: I wanted to stay in a Japanese-style room and made a reservation at an inn. However, the room I was shown to was a Western-style one.

description: A conjunction indicating that someone/something is very far from an expected state.
meaning: Far from; not just; even
example: I am far from being able to speak Japanese. I haven't studied it at all.

description: とする (1) A phrase indicating that someone assumes something.
meaning: Assume that; regard ~ as; let; suppose
example: We assume that the temperature is constant.

description: A phrase which expresses the idea that someone or something becomes something.
meaning: Become
example: Mr. Yoshida has become the first committee chairman.

description: A phrase which expresses the idea "when it comes to" or "if it is true that".
meaning: When it comes to; if it is true that ~; if it is the case that ~; if it turns out that ~
example: When it comes to mechanical things, I don't understand anything.

description: A phrase which expresses the idea "not necessarily".
meaning: Not always; not necessarily
example: Frail people do not necessarily die young.

description: A conjunction in written Japanese that is used to express a concession.
meaning: No matter ~ may be; even if; at ~ -est
example: Since I studied hard I feel confident no matter what problem shows up on the test.

description: どんなに~（こと）か - A structure that indicates an exclamation about the degree to which an action or state takes/took place.
meaning: How ~ (!)

description: A phrase which is used to express the idea that A and B share a common property or do the same thing together, that two things take place at the same time, or that someone or something possesses two properties.
meaning: As well as; with; along with; at the same time; when, as; while
example: Steinbeck, as well as Hemingway, is a writer representative of American writers.

description: A phrase which is used to express the idea that someone does something or something takes place at the same time as another action or event, or that someone or something is in two states simultaneously.
meaning: At the same time (as); at the time; when; as; while; as well as ~
example: He got a job at a bank at the time of (literally: at the same time as) his graduation from college.

description: A phrase which is used when something which someone has mentioned causes an involuntary response.
meaning: When ~ mention; if ~ say that ~; when ~ say that ~; when it comes to
example: When you mention San Francisco, I remember those cable cars.

description: A phrase which is used to clarify a statement in the preceding discourse which might be misleading.
meaning: Although ~ say/said that ~; even though ~ say/said that ~
example: I have a child. Well, although I said, "child," he is already a college student (literally: he is already a college student, though).

description: An exclamatory sentential particle which is used in informal male speech.
meaning: How ~!; what ~! ~!; I wonder; I wish

description: ないことも / はないA double negative phrase used to make a conditional affirmative statement.
meaning: It isn't the case that ~ not ~; it is not that ~ not ~
example: A: Don't you read Japanese newspapers? B: I do read them, but very rarely. (literally: It isn't the case that I don't read them, but very rarely.

description: ないことも / はないA double negative phrase used to make a conditional affirmative statement.
meaning: It isn't the case that ~ not ~; it is not that ~ not ~
example: A: Don't you read Japanese newspapers? B: I do read them, but very rarely. (literally: It isn't the case that I don't read them, but very rarely.

description: An adverb used to indicate the speaker's feelings that something is impressive or his annoyance at slowness or difficulty in achieving something.
meaning: Quite; fairly; considerably; (not) easily; pretty; (not) readily
example: {Mr. Brown is / Mr. Brown, you are} remarkably good at Japanese.

description: a continuative form of ない used in written Japanese (to indicate a reason/cause for what follows if ない is attached to Adjective (い/な) and contrast if it is attached to a Noun+Copula).
meaning: Not ~ and; not ~ but
example: The Japanese final examination was not very hard, and I felt relieved.

description: If something/someone is missing.
meaning: Without
example: Without real talents one cannot get along in the society.

description: A compound particle that indicates an approximate quote of words or ideas.
meaning: (things) like ~; ~ or something like
example: There are people who say things like Japanese culture is unique, but I don't think so.

description: A phrase that is used to express insurmountable psychological or physical feelings.
meaning: Cannot help -ing; irresistibly; unbearably
example: I'm very much worried about my sick mother. (Literally: I cannot help worrying about my sick mother).

description: In a way/style that is proper to someone/something.
meaning: In one's own way; in one's own style
example: He appears to think hard in his own way.

description: A sentence final particle that expresses the speaker's feeling of great regret or sympathy.
example: If you had come here yesterday, you could have met Natsuko.

description: において/おける A compound particle which indicates the place of an action/event, a state or time.
meaning: At; on; in; during
example: Next year's general meeting will be held at the Hilton Hotel in Chicago.

description: において/おける A compound particle which indicates the place of an action/event, a state or time.
meaning: At; on; in; during
example: Next year's general meeting will be held at the Hilton Hotel in Chicago.

description: から~にかけて A structure that expresses coverage from one time/location into the other.
meaning: Through ~ into ~; through ~ on to; from ~ till/to
example: This summer I travelled on the Chinese continent from July through August.

description: Concerning something/someone.
meaning: About; on; concerning; regarding; with regard to; of
example: I am doing research on the Japanese political system.

description: A compound particle which expresses a rate or ratio.
meaning: A; per; for; on; to
example: This job will pay you six dollars an hour. (literally: You can get six dollars an hour doing this job.

description: につれて/つれ A phrase used to indicate that a change occurs in accordance with another simultaneous change.
meaning: As; in proportion to; with
example: As my Japanese became more proficient, the number of my Japanese friends increased.

description: From the standpoint of; so far as someone (or something) is concerned.
meaning: To; for
example: For us this is a problem which cannot be ignored.

description: A phrase that expresses the time when an uncontrollable state or a habitual action occurs.
meaning: When it becomes; when it comes to; when; if
example: In summer (literally: When it becomes summer), there are many days that exceed 30 degrees Celsius.

description: A conjunction/compound particle to indicate a purpose for doing something.
meaning: To; in order to; for; for the purpose of ~
example: In order to lead a rich life, health should be your primary concern.

description: A phrase that is used to indicate that an action/state mentioned in the topic phrase or clause is nothing but something.
meaning: Be nothing but ~; be simply ~
example: His words are nothing but flowery words.

description: Without any relation to a preceding event/situation.
meaning: Although; though; in spite of; despite; notwithstanding; nevertheless
example: In spite of his strenuous efforts, Ken'ichi failed the college entrance examination.

description: によって/より A particle that indicates means, cause, agent of passive sentence, or dependency on a situation.
meaning: According to; due to; owing to; because of; depending on; from ~ to; by means of; on the basis of; with; by
example: We examine unknown kanji with a Chinese character dictionary.

description: によって/より A particle that indicates means, cause, agent of passive sentence, or dependency on a situation.
meaning: According to; due to; owing to; because of; depending on; from ~ to; by means of; on the basis of; with; by
example: We examine unknown kanji with a Chinese character dictionary.

description: A compound particle to express replacement or substitution of a regular person/thing by someone/something.
meaning: In place of; replacing; on behalf of
example: In place of Professor Yamada, who is ill, Professor Suzuki taught us.

description: に反して/反する Contrary to or in contrast to.
meaning: Against; contrary to; in contrast to; in violation of; while; whereas
example: Contrary to the majority's expectations, an unknown runner won the Tokyo International Marathon this year.

description: に反して/反する Contrary to or in contrast to.
meaning: Against; contrary to; in contrast to; in violation of; while; whereas
example: Contrary to the majority's expectations, an unknown runner won the Tokyo International Marathon this year.

description: に基づいて/基づく With something as a basis.
meaning: Based upon
example: I will give you the facts. (literally: I will talk on the basis of facts.

description: に対して/対する Regarding something/someone one opposes, compares, or shows interest in regarding something/someone one opposes, compares or shows interest in.
meaning: Toward; to; in contrast to; whereas; in regard to; in; per
example: Up until now Japan has taken a closed policy toward foreign countries.

description: に対して/対する Regarding something/someone one opposes, compares, or shows interest in regarding something/someone one opposes, compares or shows interest in.
meaning: Toward; to; in contrast to; whereas; in regard to; in; per
example: Up until now Japan has taken a closed policy toward foreign countries.

description: に当たって/当たり A compound particle that indicates occasion of doing something or of having done something in formal Japanese.
meaning: On the occasion of; at; in; before; prior to
example: On the occasion of new employees' entering the company, the president threw a party at a hotel.

description: に当たって/当たり A compound particle that indicates occasion of doing something or of having done something in formal Japanese.
meaning: On the occasion of; at; in; before; prior to
example: On the occasion of new employees' entering the company, the president threw a party at a hotel.

description: に従って/従い Something spontaneously and gradually occurs in accordance with some change.
meaning: As, accordingly; in proportion to; in accordance with; following
example: As Japan's economic power has become stronger, Japanese language learners have increased, accordingly.

description: に従って/従い Something spontaneously and gradually occurs in accordance with some change.
meaning: As, accordingly; in proportion to; in accordance with; following
example: As Japan's economic power has become stronger, Japanese language learners have increased, accordingly.

description: に比べると/比べて If we compare (it) with/to; comparing (it) with.
meaning: Compared with/to; when compared with/to; in comparison to
example: Compared to (the situations) in Europe and the U.S., the housing situation in Japan is extremely poor.

description: から~に至るまで A structure that expresses a wide range of things.
meaning: Starting with ~ ending with ~; from ~ to ~
example: Mr. Smith can read Japanese widely, ranging from weekly magazines to scholastic books.

description: Something or someone is nothing more than what is stated in terms of amount, degree, status, significance, etc.
meaning: Nothing more than; not more than; mere; merely; only; just; as little/few as; that's all
example: This is nothing more than my personal opinion.

description: に関して/関する Related to.
meaning: Concerning; with regard to; about; on
example: With regard to the sales tax, the opinions of the leading party and the opposition parties conflicted.

description: A compound particle to show that only X is different from others.
meaning: (X) of all (X's); only
example: Our child, of all children, would not do such a terrible thing.

description: Not limiting something to ~.
meaning: Not limited to ~ (but also); not only ~ (but also)
example: Arranged marriage is not limited to Japan; it is practiced in other countries, too.

description: An archaic auxiliary that indicates negation.
meaning: Not
example: In the global age we cannot think of our own country alone.

description: A phrase that indicates duty, obligation or necessity.
meaning: Must; have to; should
example: In order to know Japan one has to go to Japan at least once.

description: Things of/about.
meaning: About; in terms of; related to
example: I'm going to talk about Japanese culture in my lecture tomorrow.

description: のは~のことだ A structure which focuses on a time when something takes place.
meaning: It will be/was ~ when/that ~
example: It was in May 1985 that I last met Mr. Yamada.

description: Because it is a matter of X with which/whom something is habitually the case.
meaning: Because ~ is habitually/usually/often that way; because
example: Because Nakajima is always that way (i.e., comes late), he will probably come late again today. (literally: Because it is a matter of Nakajima (who habitually comes late)).

description: A particle which expresses a limit imposed upon an action, event, or a state.
meaning: Only; just; alone
example: Please tell me just the main point.

description: （の）上で A compound particle that is used to express a preparatory action for a relatively important action.
meaning: Upon ~; after ~
example: I will reply upon careful consideration.

description: As far as ~ is concerned.
meaning: As far as ~ is concerned; as far as ~ goes; from the viewpoint/standpoint of; according to; in terms of
example: There seems to be no problem with this plan as far as the documents are concerned.

description: Under some object; under the control or influence of someone or something.
meaning: Under; in; with
example: I finished my master's thesis under Professor Suzuki's guidance.

description: A phrase indicating that something takes place or does not take place because of something.
meaning: Because of
example: Mr. Hall has gone to Tokyo on a business-related matter.

description: A particle which emphatically affirms or negates the proposition represented by the preceding verbal and other related elements.

~ばかりか~（さえ）A compound particle/conjunction which is used to connect two nouns or two sentences, the first of which is something normally expected and the second of which is something normally unexpected.
meaning: Not only ~ but also
example: In Japan not only children but even adults are reading comic books.

description: An adverbial phrase that conveys the meaning of 'not to speak of something/someone'.
meaning: Not to speak of; let alone; not to mention; to say nothing of
example: The duty of the presidency requires physical strength, not to mention brains.

description: An auxiliary which expresses the speaker's judgment that someone/something should do something or should be in some state.
meaning: Should; ought to
example: This thesis should be rewritten.

description: An auxiliary which expresses the speaker's negative volition or conjecture.
meaning: Will not; will probably not; be probably not
example: I will not ask any more favours of Hashimoto.

description: An adverb that indicates the speaker's strong belief that something is not expected to (have) become a reality.
meaning: Incredible; never thought; never dreamed; surely not; impossible; don't tell me that ~; not at all likely; absolutely not.
example: I never dreamed that Michiko would marry that kind of a guy.

description: A phrase indicating that although someone/something (or some situation) is not satisfactory it is better than someone/something else.
meaning: Better; less objectionable; preferable; might as well ~
example: If this is the salary, it would be better to quit.

description: A conjunction which connects two choices or possibilities expressed by noun phrases or sentences.
meaning: Or; either ~ or ~
example: Please pay either in cash or by check.

description: There is no point in going as far as to do something.
meaning: Not necessary (to bother) to; do not need (to go as far as) to; do not have to
example: This is a simple calculation, so it is not necessary (to bother) to use a calculator.

description: The speaker's strong determination to achieve something for others to see.
meaning: Can manage to; will definitely do; am determined to
example: I will definitely write a novel and get the Akutagawa Prize.

description: A particle which implies that something else is also (not) the case.
meaning: Also; too; (not) either; (not) even
example: Although Mr. Yoshioka is seventy this year, he runs one kilometre every day. He occasionally swims, too.

description: An adverb to indicate that something desirable has been finally achieved or will be eventually achieved though with great difficulty.
meaning: Finally; at last; barely
example: I finally finished writing my Japanese history term paper.

description: やる (1) To cause something/someone to move to a place or to do/eat/drink something.
meaning: Send; give; do; play; operate; eat; drink
example: Poor families cannot send their children to college.

description: よう (1) A noun forming suffix which means a way (of doing something).
meaning: A/the way to; a/the way of -ing; the way (someone does something)
example: There is no way to correct this composition.

description: A phrase which negates the existence of a reason to believe that someone does something or is in some state, or that something takes place; or which negates a possibility of someone's doing something or being in some state, or something's taking place.
meaning: There is no reason why ~; it is impossible (for ~) to ~; cannot
example: There is no reason why you cannot do such an easy job.

description: A phrase which is used to deny what is implied in the previous or following statement.
meaning: It does not mean that ~; I don't mean that ~; it is not that ~; it is not true that ~; it is not the case that
example: It is very difficult to solve this problem. But that does not mean that it is impossible (to solve).

description: A phrase which is used to indicate that one cannot do something due to an external circumstance.
meaning: Cannot; cannot but ~; cannot help -ing; have no (other) choice but to ~
example: There will be final examinations next week, so I cannot fool around this weekend.

description: A compound particle that is used to indicate a medium through which something is done or time through which something takes place.
meaning: Through; by the medium of; via; throughout
example: I became acquainted with the pianist through a close friend of mine.

description: 一方で（は） ~ 他方で（は）A structure used to describe two concurring, contrastive actions/states of someone or something.
meaning: On the one hand ~, on the other hand
example: Professor Kanda teaches physics at college on the one hand and does research on Japanese language on the other.

description: A suffix which indicates the idea of "from the viewpoint of," "for the sake of," "for the reason," or "in terms of".
meaning: From the viewpoint of; for (the sake of); for (the reason); in (terms of); relating to; in –ing
example: This film is not good from an educational point of view.

description: （の）上で A compound particle that is used to express a preparatory action for a relatively important action.
meaning: Upon ~; after ~
example: I will reply upon careful consideration.

description: 上（に）A conjunction which introduces an additional, emphatic statement.
meaning: As well; in addition; besides; furthermore; moreover; not only ~ but also
example: Besides the fact that this movie has an interesting storyline, the cast is good.

description: （の）代わりに An action/state that is expressed in the subordinate clause is balanced by another action/state expressed in the main clause, or something/someone that is replaced by something/someone else.
meaning: Instead of; instead; but (to make up for ~); so (to make up for ~); in place of
example: I am going to enjoy myself in the daytime, so /but (to make up for it) I will study at night.

description: 以上（は）A conjunction indicating the speaker/writer's feeling that there should be a very strong logical/natural connection between wht precedes the conjunction and what follows it.
meaning: Since; now that; once; if ~ at all; as long as; so long as
example: Since I came to Japan, I would like to study Japanese hard.

description: A dependent noun which means "something/someone other than".
meaning: Other than; except (for); but; besides; as well as
example: Everybody except Yamada knows it.

description: An adverb that indicates the speaker's emotive feeling about some extreme state of affairs.
meaning: As a matter of fact; no matter what; believe it or not; you may be surprised, but ~; in fact; unbelievably
example: My father is obstinate. As a matter of fact, once he says he will do something, he never changes his mind.

description: A phrase that indicates the speaker's uncertainty about something.
meaning: I don't know for sure, but
example: I don't know for sure, but they say that Mr. Yamamoto has separated from his wife and lives alone.

description: A phrase which signals that the referent of the following noun phrase is definite and that the speaker expects the hearer to understand what the referent is.
meaning: The ~ (in question); that (same); the usual

description: A suffix which indicates the amount of something.
meaning: For ~; ~ worth; amount equivalent to ~; portion
example: I put in ten dollars worth of gas.

description: 得る　（うる・える）An auxiliary verb that expresses possibility.
meaning: Can; possible; -able
example: I think it's possible for the Japanese language to become an international language in the 21st century.

description: An adverb that indicates that the proposition expressed in the sentence is not always true.
meaning: Not always; not necessarily
example: A bright person does not always succeed.

description: A verb that indicates what the speaker/writer feels spontaneously or his/her hesitation about asserting himself/herself.
meaning: Seem; appear; apparently
example: It seems that the business conditions of the coming year will be better than those of this year.

description: A phrase to indicate a manner of doing something.
meaning: Do something in a ~ fashion/manner/way
example: Professor Hayashida teaches in a strict manner.

description: During a certain amount of time (something has continued up until the moment of speech or something has never been like the current state).
meaning: For; in; since
example: Tom has been studying Japanese for the past 20 years.

description: A conjunction/noun to express that an action indicated by a preceding verb or an action implied by a preceding noun is a prerequisite for another action.
meaning: As soon as; depend on
example: As soon as I get to Osaka, I will call you.

description: A suffix which represents an ordinal number.
meaning: -th; -th one
example: My car is the second one from the right.

description: A noun which expresses the idea "as a result of".
meaning: As a result of; after; upon
example: As a result of the vote, the proposal was rejected by the majority's opposition.

description: An adverb that indicates that something exceeds the speaker's and/or hearer's expectation to a considerable degree.
meaning: Quite; rather; pretty

description: An adverb to introduce an event which takes place contrary to one's expectation/intention, or an action or event which is converse to that stated in the preceding sentence or clause.
meaning: Contrary to one's expectation; contrary to one's intention; conversely
example: Contrary to expectations, when I took medicine, I got a fever.

description: 途端（に）A noun/adverb which expresses the idea that 'something occurred the moment someone did something or something took place'.
meaning: The moment; just as; as soon as; then
example: The moment I saw my teacher, I remembered that there was a homework assignment.

description: 通り（に）A dependent noun which expresses the idea that someone does something or something takes place in the same way as something else.
meaning: (in) the same way as; (in) the way; as
example: I did it as the manual shows (literally: in the same way as the manual), but it didn't work.

description: 通り（に）A dependent noun which expresses the idea that someone does something or something takes place in the same way as something else.
meaning: (in) the same way as; (in) the way; as
example: I did it as the manual shows (literally: in the same way as the manual), but it didn't work.

description: A conjunction which expresses the idea "as long as (a certain condition is met)" or "as long as (= to the extent)".
meaning: As long as; as far as; while; to the extent; until; unless
example: As long as I am here, you don't have to worry.

description: A suffix which forms a compound that means a side of X, or an aspect of X.
meaning: (on) the side of; (from) the aspect of; (from) the standpoint/viewpoint of; in terms of
example: He is excellent in terms of his academic performance (literally: on the side of his academic performance) but he seems to have some psychological weakness (literally: have some weakness on the side of his psychology).

description: With an appearance/style/tone/manner of ~.
meaning: In ~ manner; after ~ style; a la ~; like
example: The yard of my house has big rocks arranged in Japanese style.
